rights_basis: This focused transcription reproduces one Latin sentence by Thomas Aquinas from the public-domain 1888 Leonine edition. It contains no Internet Archive interface text, OCR, annotations, or protected translation, and Triptych claims no exclusive right in the source wording.
text: Respondeo dicendum quod necessarium fuit ad humanam salutem, esse doctrinam quandam secundum revelationem divinam, praeter philosophicas disciplinas, quae ratione humana investigantur.
